thread:
emma nguyen: Quick metrics check — post-launch week 1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/boards/launch-ops. Noticing webinar sign-up -> MQL conversion dropped to 4.1% yesterday from 6.2% last week. Anybody see routing changes or UTM shifts? :eyes:

sachin patel: I saw an attribution window tweak on Friday in GA4 — a test moved it 30d -> 7d for a segment. Could cut downstream attributed MQLs. :thinking:

jordan lee: Can you paste the exact cohort/chart? I looked at sessions -> signups funnel and acquisition is flat, drop is at form completion stage.

emma nguyen: Chart 7 on the board has the spike -> drop. Also seeing an uptick in utm_source = (unknown).

lina garcia: Ops checked routing rules — nothing changed server-side. But front-end deploy yesterday included a referrer parsing regex tweak. cc @ryan (data)

ryan (data): Confirmed — front-end regex was tightened. Running a quick query to surface affected leads. SQL I'm running: 
```
SELECT utm_source, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
```
Will share results in ~10m.

ops-bot: [Alert] webinar_mql_conversion dropped 34% (24h) — threshold breached. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.com/alert/5234

sachin patel: If attribution window is shortened AND referrer parsing broke, that's a double impact. My suggestion: rollback the frontend regex change + pause the GA4 window test to 30d for the campaign while we validate.

emma nguyen: Agree. Lina — can you coordinate rollback? Jordan — can you add a dashboard comparison (7d vs 30d) for the next 48h so we can see magnitude?

lina garcia: On it. Rolling back front-end regex now. Will confirm when deployed. :thumbsup:

jordan lee: I'll add comparison tiles and a note on the board. ETA 45m.

ryan (data): Quick results: top utm_source counts since 3/15 — unknown: 412, newsletter: 198, paid: 153. Saved a view: dash.redwood.com/views/lead-utm-breakdown. Looks like ~25% of yesterday's form submissions lost utm.

emma nguyen: Solid — action items: 1) rollback confirmed in thread; 2) dashboard snapshot (7d vs 30d); 3) tiny postmortem in weekly KPI doc with root cause + prevention. I'll spin up a 15m huddle if conversion doesn't recover by EOD. :calendar:

sachin patel: Also recommend adding a synthetic form submit test to CI that validates utm parsing so future deploys catch this.

lina garcia: Good call — adding to deploy checklist.

emma nguyen: Thanks everyone. Will update here as soon as rollback is live and dashboard tiles are up.
